title: KOG Coach Debrief
summary: KOG opened 2026–27 with a 74–67 win over Skuru. The scorebook points to a shared scoring load, composure across the four quarters, and a disciplined defensive effort.
source: Official match protocol: Kungsholmen OG 74–67 Skuru Basket, 19 September 2026.

highlights.title: Shared scoring load
highlights.note: Max Landgren (16) and Hawsoon Jobe (15) led the way, while six other scorers added 43 points. KOG did not need one player to carry the offense.

highlights.title: Closed the game
highlights.note: KOG led just 38–37 at half, then kept winning the margins to finish seven points ahead.

highlights.title: Multiple ways to score
highlights.stat: 30 made field goals · 7 made threes · 7 made free throws
highlights.note: Seven threes — four from Hawsoon — gave KOG a perimeter route alongside 23 made two-pointers.

highlights.title: Foul discipline
highlights.note: KOG committed five fewer team fouls in the protocol, an important edge in a close game.

takeaways: Keep trusting the extra pass and the whole rotation: eight different players found points.
Use the same calm finish next game: win the last quarter, protect the lead, and make the opponent chase.

title: KOG Coach Debrief
summary: KOG fell 55–68 at Tumba, but there were clear positives to take forward: the team matched Tumba 32–32 after halftime and won the fourth quarter 16–14. The response and shared contribution were there throughout a difficult road game.
source: Official match protocol: Tumba Basket 68–55 Kungsholmen OG, 10 October 2026.

highlights.title: Stayed in the fight after halftime
highlights.note: KOG trailed 23–37 at the break, then matched Tumba 16–17 in the third and won the final quarter 16–14. That is a response the group can build on.

highlights.title: Max gave KOG a reliable scoring base
highlights.note: Max consistently finished around the basket and converted five free throws, creating a dependable inside option in every quarter.

highlights.title: A reshaped group contributed
highlights.stat: 25 pts from Rudolfs, Mehmet, Lucas, Chuma & Hassan
highlights.note: Mehmet scored 12 and Lucas added 6, while Rudolfs, Chuma and Hassan all contributed. That depth is a very positive foundation for the next games.

highlights.title: Perimeter answers in the finish
highlights.note: Lucas hit two threes and Hawsoon one. Those shots helped KOG win the final quarter and showed that the offense can attack in more than one way.

takeaways: Carry the second-half standard into the next game: compete possession by possession, communicate, and finish quarters with purpose.
Keep creating early finishing opportunities for Max, then use the perimeter threat to open the floor for the whole group.

title: KOG Coach Debrief
summary: KOG fell 59–60 at Odysseas after leading 18–13 after Q1 and 38–33 at halftime. Odysseas won Q3 12–6, then both teams scored 15 in Q4. KOG led 59–57 with five seconds left before #7 hit a lucky banked three. That left KOG 2.2 seconds for the final possession, but no shot went up before the buzzer.
source: Official match protocol for score and scoring actions; KOG's post-game account for the final five-second sequence.

highlights.title: Built an early lead
highlights.note: KOG controlled the opening quarter and carried a five-point advantage into the break.

highlights.title: Third quarter was the swing
highlights.note: KOG’s lowest-scoring quarter left the team one point behind entering Q4. The protocol does not show missed shots or possessions, so the cause is not visible in the score sheet.

highlights.title: Had the lead late
highlights.stat: Five seconds left · KOG led 59–57 · KOG had 2.2 seconds for its final possession
highlights.note: KOG's post-game account says #7 Ioannis Katsaros hit a lucky banked three with five seconds left. KOG had 2.2 seconds after the basket but could not get a shot away before the buzzer. The protocol itself has no game clock.

highlights.title: Scoring came from across the roster
highlights.stat: Hawsoon Jobe 15 · Randall Brar Kalala 12 · Rudolfs Dzelzkalejs 11
highlights.note: The three leading scorers combined for 38 points; four more KOG players added points.

highlights.title: Made 24 field goals
highlights.note: KOG made 24 field goals and eight free throws for 59 points. The protocol does not list attempts, so shooting percentages cannot be calculated.

takeaways: Prepare a clear opening action after halftime: KOG scored 20 in Q2 and 6 in Q3.
Rehearse a 2.2-second final possession with an immediate inbound and shot option; KOG could not get a shot away after Odysseas took the lead.
Keep the scoring contributions spread across the roster; the three leading KOG scorers supplied 38 of the 59 points.
KOG recorded 18 team fouls, including eight in Q4. Stay physical while avoiding unnecessary late fouls.
